title: POST /api/v1/peer/documents/search
description: docs/mesh-design.md §2, lot P0. A trusted computer of the account (a `peer:` session whose requester_computer_id is in the verified vault roster) searches this computer's documents. Request: definitions/request; 200: definitions/response; 400/403/429: definitions/error. Draft-07 so that Fastify's Ajv compiles it as is (app.addSchema(this), then {$ref: 'peer-documents-search.schema.json#/definitions/request'}); compile with removeAdditional off so an unknown field is refused, not dropped.
$comment: No absolute path anywhere: a passage or file says `folder` (the display name of the granted root, never its path) and `rel_path` (POSIX, relative to that root). source_id = '<computer_id>:<document_id>' where computer_id is this computer's account_computers id (the same as the response's computer_id) and document_id its local documents.id (src/vault/contracts.ts sourceId/parseSourceId). A citation is twoody://doc/<computer_id>/<document_id>. The caller's identity comes from its session, never from this body. Retrieval: retrieveDocuments with absolutePaths:false; scope ∩ this computer's own grants; semantic skipped while this computer is generating; 30 requests/min/session; each request audited.

local_id.description: A local id of this computer (documents.id, document_folders.id: 32 hex today).

display_name.description: A file or folder name: no slash, no backslash, no control character.

rel_path.description: POSIX path relative to the granted root, the file's name last: not absolute, no drive letter, no '~', no backslash, no empty, '.' or '..' segment, no trailing slash.

q.description: The question as the answering computer searches it (follow-up context already folded in).

hint.description: The previous user turn, for follow-ups (« résume-le »).

budget_chars.description: Sum of passages[].text lengths, at most.

deadline_ms.description: Answer with what is found by then; semantic search is the first thing skipped.

examples.q: Quelle est la date de fin du contrat Dupont ?

rank.description: 1 = this computer's best passage; the caller fuses lists by reciprocal rank.

cosine.description: Only for semantic matches; comparable across computers only when embed_model is the same.

documents.description: Indexed documents in the caller's scope.

pending.description: Documents in scope still being indexed.

passages.name: contrat-dupont.pdf
passages.text: Le présent contrat prend fin le 31 décembre 2027.
passages.snippet: Le présent contrat prend fin le 31 décembre 2027.

passages.snippet: Entre Dupont SARL et Osmove SASU…

error.description: 400 bad_request (body refused by this schema), 403 not_trusted (requester not in the verified roster, or no session of a peer), 403 documents_off (this computer shares no folder), 429 rate_limited (with retry_after_s).
